DIAGNOSIS READY: Secondary Syphilis.

Based on your history of a longstanding pruritic rash combined with the classic "numbness and tingling" on the palms (a sign of early syphilitic neuropathy), along with negative autoimmune and diabetic workup, this presentation is highly suggestive of secondary syphilis. Please proceed with a Rapid Plasma Reagin (RPR) and Treponema Pallidum Particle Agglutination (TP-PA) test to confirm the diagnosis.
